note: 東清、漁人的關鍵人物（K5 / K2 與後續 IM-V、IT-V 任務）。after：完成某任務後改說的話。

greet.en: Hey, hello! Here to visit Iranmeylek?

duty.zh: 我開民宿、帶導覽，也跟長輩學出海。
duty.en: I run a guesthouse, lead tours, and I'm learning to go to sea with the elders.

lines.zh: 早上的東清灣人最多，中午就安靜了。
lines.en: Dongqing Bay is busiest in the morning. By noon it's quiet.

lines.zh: 帶導覽的時候，我都先講規矩，再講風景。
lines.en: On my tours, I always explain the rules first, then the scenery.

lines.zh: 晚上的灣邊最舒服，風吹著，什麼都不用想。
lines.en: The bay is nicest at night. The wind blows and you don't have to think about anything.

lines.zh: 飛魚季的時候，我會提醒客人不要進灘頭。
lines.en: In flying fish season, I remind guests not to go onto the boat beach.

lines.zh: 冬天遊客少，正好整理房子，也陪陪阿爸。
lines.en: Fewer tourists in winter. A good time to fix up the house and spend time with Dad.

IM-V1.zh: 海灣乾淨多了，謝謝你們。
IM-V1.en: The bay is much cleaner. Thank you.

IM-V2.zh: 那天晚上說了好多，你們不要笑我。
IM-V2.en: I said so much that night. Don't laugh at me.

greet.zh: 你們好！要去機場嗎？順路的話我載你們。
greet.en: Hello! Going to the airport? I can give you a lift if it's on my way.

duty.zh: 我在漁人做小生意，也照顧家裡的長輩。
duty.en: I run a small business in Iratay and look after the elders at home.

lines.zh: 飛機又誤點了，風太大。島上的人都習慣了。
lines.en: The plane is late again. Too windy. People here are used to it.

lines.zh: 我媽每次去臺灣看病，我都要請假陪她。
lines.en: Every time Mum goes to Taiwan to see a doctor, I take time off to go with her.

lines.zh: 學校操場晚上很熱鬧，孩子們在練唱歌。
lines.en: The school field is lively at night. The kids are practising songs.

lines.zh: 夏天遊客多，生意比較好，可是也比較累。
lines.en: Lots of tourists in summer. Business is better, but it's tiring too.

lines.zh: 冬天船常常停駛，東西都要先買好。
lines.en: Boats often stop in winter, so you have to buy things in advance.

IT-V1.zh: 我媽一直說你們很有禮貌。
IT-V1.en: My mum keeps saying how polite you are.

NT4.zh: 昨天的晚會好玩吧？孩子們唱得很好聽。
NT4.en: Fun party last night, right? The kids sang so well.
